appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.hint: Applies to every workspace and is saved in your personal settings.

language.title: Language
language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Messages from databases and SSH servers are shown as they arrive.

history.title: History
history.stored: Every query you run from the app is saved on this computer with its connection, time, duration, row count and error. Opening a saved query never runs it.
history.perConnection: Saving is set per connection: open the “⋯” menu next to a connection in the sidebar. Turn it off before running SQL with passwords or other secrets. Turning it off keeps the queries already saved.
history.audit: This history belongs to the desktop app. Queries from AI agents (spelunk mcp) go to a separate audit log.
